pages.text: Where energy enters a power network. A [[heat_turbine|turbine]], another mod's generator, or a cable feeds it from right next to it. It holds just 2,000 FE, passing the rest on.

**Linking:** use a [[linking_bar]] on one station or [[substation]], then another, up to **64 blocks** apart. Each takes up to 4 links. Shift-use the bar to unlink and get the bars back.

**Rails:** a [[charging_rail]] needs no linking: it draws from the nearest station or substation in range.

**Several stations:** build them so their ranges overlap. If a rail is out of range of one or its network runs dry, it uses the next.
